name: rapidkit-vscode
description: Workspace Intelligence for VS Code. Adopt, import, scaffold, diagnose, verify, and govern polyglot workspaces with shared evidence for developers, CI, and AI agents.

chatParticipants.name: workspai
chatParticipants.description: Ask questions, debug, and plan across your Workspai workspace with shared context for people and AI agents.

commands.name: ask
commands.description: Ask anything about your project — architecture, modules, conventions, best practices.

commands.name: debug
commands.description: Debug errors and diagnostics with full project context and get a structured fix.

commands.name: repair
commands.description: Repair a canonical blocker through the governed Workspai CLI Repair Engine.

commands.name: goal
commands.description: Turn one plain-language engineering outcome into a governed, evidence-bound Goal Pack.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Workspai
walkthroughs.description: Build a shared, evidence-backed understanding of your workspace for humans and AI — model, health, and agent grounding.

steps.title: Open the Workspai dashboard
steps.description:
Open the Workspai dashboard to see workspace health, evidence, and the governance gate in one place.
[Open Workspai](command:workspai.showWelcome)

steps.title: Create or select a workspace
steps.description:
Point Workspai at a workspace. You can create a new one or adopt an existing project.
[Create Workspace](command:workspai.createWorkspace)

steps.title: Generate your first workspace model
steps.description:
Build the workspace model — the dependency-graph-aware map that powers impact, verify, and AI grounding.
[Generate Workspace Model](command:workspai.workspaceModel)

steps.title: Run Doctor until it is green
steps.description:
Run Workspace Doctor, resolve blocking findings, and review or document advisory warnings.
[Run Doctor](command:workspai.doctorEvidence.rerun)

steps.title: Sync agent grounding
steps.description:
Write the shared grounding (AGENTS.md + reports index) so Copilot, Cursor, and other agents use the same evidence you do.
[Sync Agent Grounding](command:workspai.workspaceAgentSync)

enumDescriptions: Silently refresh workspace intelligence before AI actions when the evidence is stale or missing.
Warn before AI actions when the evidence is stale or missing, with an option to refresh.
Never gate AI actions on evidence freshness.
workspai.evidenceFreshnessGate.markdownDescription: Controls the evidence-freshness gate before AI actions (Send to Copilot, agent grounding). When the workspace intelligence evidence is stale (per the dependency-graph-aware `workspace verify` verdict or its age) or missing, Workspai can auto-refresh it, warn you, or do nothing.

enumDescriptions: Generate portable grounding only (INDEX.json, AGENTS.md, pack report).
Generate the full VS Code-native pack (instructions, prompts, skills, agents, MCP design).
workspai.agentSync.preset.markdownDescription: Preset passed to `npx workspai workspace agent-sync` when Workspai dispatches Agent Grounding Sync or preflights Send-to-Copilot.

workspai.agentSync.experimentalHooks.markdownDescription: When enabled, Workspai passes `--experimental-hooks` to `npx workspai workspace agent-sync`. Hooks stay advisory and disabled by default in the CLI.

workspai.studio.sidebarOnly.markdownDescription: Keeps Incident Studio in the Workspai secondary sidebar. Legacy dashboard Studio webview messages are ignored when this is enabled, preventing duplicate repair surfaces.

enumDescriptions: Tauri via the official create-tauri-app generator
VS Code Extension via the official generator-code scaffold
Laravel via the official Composer generator

workspai.autoRefresh.description: Automatically refresh project tree when files change

workspai.showWelcomeOnStartup.description: Show welcome page when extension activates

workspai.showOnboardingTips.description: Show in-product onboarding tips for Workspai AI and operational workflows

workspai.terminal.autoActivate.description: Automatically activate Python environment in integrated terminal

workspai.git.autoInit.description: Initialize git repository for new projects

workspai.dontShowFirstTimeSetup.description: Don't show first-time setup welcome message

workspai.networkTimeoutMs.description: Network timeout in milliseconds for examples and kits fetching

workspai.commandTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for local CLI and git commands used by the extension (AI scanning, module discovery, and diagnostics)

workspai.aiStreamTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for AI model streaming responses. Keep this higher than local command timeouts for preview models.

workspai.preferredModel.markdownDescription: Preferred AI model for Workspai AI features. Use `auto` to pick the best entitled VS Code language model, or set a specific model id/name from `Developer: Show Language Model Information`. Requires GitHub Copilot or another compatible language-model extension.

enumDescriptions: Follow the active VS Code color theme
Force Workspai webviews to use the light palette
Force Workspai webviews to use the dark palette
workspai.themeMode.description: Appearance mode for Workspai dashboard, setup, settings, and Studio webviews.

enumDescriptions: Use VS Code language models such as GitHub Copilot.
Use the OpenAI API with a key stored in VS Code Secret Storage.
Use Claude through Anthropic's native Messages API.
Use Google Gemini through its OpenAI-compatible API.
Use Kimi through the Moonshot AI API.
Use DeepSeek chat and reasoning models.
Use a custom OpenAI-compatible API endpoint with the key stored in VS Code Secret Storage.
workspai.aiProvider.markdownDescription: AI provider used by Workspai Studio and AI workflows.

workspai.customAIBaseUrl.markdownDescription: Legacy base URL setting for the custom OpenAI-compatible provider. Provider-specific endpoints are managed by `workspai.aiProviderProfiles`.

workspai.customAIModel.markdownDescription: Legacy model setting for the custom OpenAI-compatible provider. Provider-specific models are managed by `workspai.aiProviderProfiles`.

workspai.aiProviderProfiles.markdownDescription: Per-provider endpoint and model overrides managed by the Workspai Settings view. API keys are never stored here; they remain in VS Code Secret Storage.

scripts.build: corepack npm run clean:dist && corepack npm run esbuild-base -- --production && corepack npm run webview:build:production
scripts.build:release: corepack npm run check:cli-release-contracts && corepack npm run clean:dist && corepack npm run esbuild-base:release -- --production && corepack npm run webview:build:production
scripts.compile: corepack npm run clean:dist && tsc -p ./ && corepack npm run build:cli-runtime && corepack npm run webview:build
scripts.sync:cli-release-policy: node scripts/cli-release-policy.mjs --write && corepack npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts && node scripts/cli-release-policy.mjs
scripts.esbuild-base: corepack npm run build:cli-runtime && node esbuild.js
scripts.esbuild-base:release: corepack npm run build:cli-runtime:release && node esbuild.js
scripts.webview:build: cd webview-ui && corepack npm run build
scripts.webview:build:production: cd webview-ui && corepack npm run build -- --production
scripts.webview:watch: cd webview-ui && corepack npm run watch
scripts.pretest: corepack npm run check:cli-release-policy && corepack npm run typecheck && corepack npm run lint
scripts.lint: corepack npm run check:english-text && eslint src --ext ts
scripts.validate:contracts: corepack npm run check:shared-contracts && corepack npm run check:palette-surface && vitest run src/test/importStackParity.snapshot.test.ts src/test/runtimeCommandSurfaceParity.test.ts src/test/contractWorkflow.test.ts src/test/npmContractSupportMatrix.test.ts src/test/paletteCommandSurface.test.ts
scripts.test:ai-reliability: vitest run src/test/aiReliabilityGate.test.ts src/test/aiService.test.ts src/test/aiContextResolver.test.ts src/test/chatParticipant.test.ts src/test/driftGuard.test.ts src/test/incidentStudioPolicyGates.test.ts src/test/incidentStudioResponseValidator.test.ts src/test/incidentStudioTelemetry.test.ts src/test/studioRedesignContracts.test.ts
scripts.package:ci: corepack npm run check:cli-release-policy && corepack npm run check:english-text && node scripts/package-vsix-variants.mjs --release-only && corepack npm run smoke:cli-first-run
scripts.publish:ci: corepack npm run publish:guard && vsce publish --packagePath rapidkit-vscode-${npm_package_version}.vsix
scripts.validate: corepack npm run check:cli-release-policy && corepack npm run check:local-paths && corepack npm run typecheck && corepack npm run lint && corepack npm run format:check && corepack npm test
